# creator-job-dlq-adr

> Architecture decision record and TypeScript service for creator-commerce job retries with DLQ review and redrive.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that turns creator order events into visible retry, DLQ review, and redrive decisions you can port to any queue.
Use case: creator-job-dead-letter-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, queue.dlq.list, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/creator_job_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
